title: Nexus: Important Systems
summary: Read the Nexus signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Core access keys, scanners, visors, utility items, and anomaly states can all signal different threat levels.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch anomaly state, access keys, scanner output, route exits, gear condition, and wording that suggests a cost, counter, or escalation.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Nexus system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
